parts.text:
I am working on INF-2300 Assignment 2, where I need to build a TODO-list web client that communicates with a provided REST API.

I want you to create ONLY the frontend interface structure and styling. Do NOT implement any application logic, API communication, fetch calls, event listeners, or JavaScript functionality.

Create:

1. `index.html`
2. `style.css`
The interface should contain:

- A clear title/header for the TODO application.
- A text input where the user can type a new TODO item.
- An "Add" button.
- A section/list where TODO items will later be rendered dynamically using JavaScript.
- A "Clear all" button.
- A dedicated area for displaying error messages from the client/server.
- Each dynamically created TODO item should be designed to eventually support:

- displaying the item name
- showing whether it is completed
- a button for marking it completed
- a delete button
Important constraints:

- Do NOT add any JavaScript.
- Do NOT add inline `onclick` handlers.
- Do NOT make API requests.
- Do NOT implement TODO functionality.
- Do NOT add React, Vue, Bootstrap, Tailwind, or any other framework/library.
- Use only plain HTML and CSS.
- Keep the code simple and readable for a university student.
- Give important elements clear IDs/classes so I can access them later from my own JavaScript.
- Use semantic HTML where reasonable.
- Keep the styling clean, simple, and professional rather than overly decorative.
Suggested IDs:

- `todoInput`
- `addButton`
- `todoList`
- `clearButton`
- `errorMessage`
Place styling in a separate `style.css` file and reference it from `index.html`.

The goal is that I write all JavaScript and API functionality myself afterwards.
